question: Can the native Hybrid infer an unfamiliar causal operator from a short, matched history of actual action-consequence observations, generalizing to held-out input bindings and delayed queries, without any engineered operator algebra, privileged teacher or old scored data?

scientific_hypotheses.primary: A learned native memory mechanism infers unseen operator behavior from six actual factual interventions in one episode and beats the strongest adequately trained non-handcoded memory/control on new physical heldout operator families.
scientific_hypotheses.mechanistic: True support consequence observations provide an incremental gain versus otherwise identical shuffled, zero-consequence and zero-memory controls, with adaptation persisting through a query delay.
scientific_hypotheses.identity: A native-internal learned mechanism outperforms an information-matched EXTERNAL learned representation/control; merely matching its performance is not native-specific benefit.

source.support_policy: SIX deterministic precommitted probe actions per episode; public action/time and only its own actually realized nine-tick reward are exposed. Same episode latent operator applies to independently physically regenerated A-factor views; no oracle counterfactual or future query results.
source.query_policy: One heldout independently regenerated causal input/binding and choice after six support actions; 9-tick realized reward observed ONLY by evaluator after all weights and within-episode adaptation have frozen. Paired unchosen actions evaluator-only.
source.families_for_train: Only known families above; new unseen families appear first in heldout DEV_UNKNOWN/OOD_SHIFT/DELAYED_COLD/REVERSAL after all learned parameters, hyperparameters and selected hypotheses fixed.
source.operator_implementation: Evaluator/physical-world generator only: deterministic 3-argument Boolean action-consequence semantics; no public opcode MUX/PARITY/NEGATION, precomputed law sign, truth table, operator ID, embedded operator function, or engineered algebra in the learner features. Evaluator implementation is isolated from model imports.
source.cue_roles: Public noisy actual A-factor cues, three role assignments and chosen action/timing; equivariant role handling may be learned with shared weights/permutation pooling, never hard-coded Boolean functions.
source.operator_identity: No unique episode- or family-stable code exposed. Inference must use within-episode factual support evidence and public input/action/roles, never a memorized family label.
source.physics: Use R85 224-tick pure physical simulator and R86 pure permitted shifts as independently regenerated new worlds; never call any prior _world panel/cached scored state. Each support observation results from an actual selected intervention and actual 9-tick physical return.
source.episode_construction: Support and query are separate independent physics draws conditioned only on the same hidden causal operator family. Source indexes, role permutations and time strata are fixed by seed/panel/index; no reward-selected rejection sampling or adaptive source choice.
source.train_validation_access: FIT/VALID factual support + actual chosen query returns solely for supervised learning. VALID is report-only, no parameter selection, no early stopping. DEV/OOD/COLD/REVERSAL are never used by optimizer or for posthoc model selection.
source.unseen_scope: Unseen Boolean operator definitions (not new physical dynamical laws); no general AGI, 224-tick recurrent retention or official GPU conclusion.
source.public_identifiability_audit: Before scoring, report source balance and whether support observations distinguish candidate operator definitions under observed noisy rewards; source invalid if predefined balanced action/time/role coverage or deterministic suite integrity fails. Never redraw cohorts after seeing outcomes.

models.native_reference: Unmodified original R74 width32 HybridPilot_FULL plus R75 triangular TTT, SSM/causal attention/TTT/depth; isolate trainable support-memory adapter from the production model; no model.py changes.
models.learned_relation: Neural shared equivariant support encoder + learned bounded episode state updated sequentially from PUBLIC chosen action, actual selected reward, cue and role observations. No explicit Boolean function/law operation, custom reward-sign oracle or evaluator import inside model.
models.probe_cost: Every arm receives the exact six interventions and factual rewards and identical new query cues/action choices; active actions, number of observations and memory capacity constraints held fixed.
models.parameter_compute: Match native-internal learned-state and external learned-state adapters within 10% trainable parameters and active FLOPs when possible; record all params, actual total measured CPU wall time, active FLOPs and source-generation cost; otherwise performance is only TEST development and cannot claim compute-superior science.
models.conventional: Train full-step role-equivariant support-set, GRU64 support history, and flattened MLP memory controls without engineered operator programs. Strongest qualified one is the scientific comparator.
models.engineered_upper: Physical evaluator truth-table oracle is diagnostic ONLY, explicitly receives hidden law; not counted as learned or used for selection/training.

controls.support_shuffle: Deterministic seed-only derangement among support observation slots matched for public action/time strata, independent of reward/private law. Scramble ONLY support outcome pairings, preserve query factual reward; audit nontrivial perturbation and no fixed points before score.
controls.no_outcome: Identical state updater input/architecture and query access with support rewards masked to constant; preserve six support observations/action access.
controls.state_reset: Same trained and initialized native architecture with episode memory reset before query, no change to query inputs.
controls.role_permutation: All arms tested on unseen role permutations and independently sampled physical factors; operator identity never exposed.
controls.strong_baselines: Fully trained nonhandcoded role-set, GRU and MLP plus external same-capacity learned-state comparator.
controls.evaluator_truth_oracle: Evaluator-only upper, never train/feature input, never claimed as discovery.

evaluation.primary: Mean physically realized reward on independent DEV_UNKNOWN from pre-query action selection, after fixed six factual supports.
evaluation.relation_inference_not_invention: Even all PASS means bounded unfamiliar-family behavior inference from short factual interventions, not invention of arbitrary new operator types/AGI; hidden families are evaluator-defined.

engineering.implementation_scope: Isolated new experiments/r101_unknown_operator_diagnostic.py and tests/test_r101_unknown_operator_diagnostic.py plus branch-scoped seed jobs in EXISTING G4 after complete G4 Linux/Windows; no overwrite existing model/core or tests.
engineering.admission: Never generate new scored DEV/unknown panels until exact source clean SHA, original GitHub-hosted Ubuntu CPU first-attempt, matching branch/job/seed/run and successful G4 dual-OS source/negative-controls qualification are verified.
engineering.original_first_use_run_and_sha: Must be pinned once from independently verified original G4 job; no replay on changed source or subsequent run; prior scored cohorts remain permanently fenced.
engineering.G5_G7: Same exact SHA native authentic TTT CPU both platforms and pinned Mamba2 import qualification separately; no GPU first use.
engineering.post_scoring: Source seal on a subsequent SHA, regression without replaying DEV scored cohorts, preserve signed receipts and both negative findings and gains.
